name: triangulene triplet ground state and singlet-triplet gap

prompt.query: Determine the ground-state spin multiplicity of triangulene (the smallest non-Kekulen polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon) and its singlet-triplet gap. Species SMILES: [CH]1C2=C3C(=CC=C2)[CH]C4=CC=CC5=C4C3=C6C1=CC=CC6=C5; total charge 0, multiplicity 3; conditions: gas phase (surface-synthesis analogue). Atom-mapped reactant SMILES: [CH:1]1[c:2]2[c:3]3[c:4]([cH:5][cH:6][cH:7]2)[CH:8][c:9]2[cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][c:13]4[c:14]2[c:15]-3[c:16]2[c:17]1[cH:18][cH:19][cH:20][c:21]2[cH:22]4. The 1-based map numbers in it are the indexing convention for `bond_changes` (keep using the plain SMILES above for graph nodes and evidence annotations). Model the process you investigate as a graph and maintain `mechanism_graph.json` in the sandbox root: nodes for every species or electronic state you characterize (with SMILES) and edges for the state changes or transformations between them (with `via` pointing to the TS node id when a transition state was located). Extra nodes or edges beyond the reference are never penalized, so record every state you actually characterized. Every elementary-step edge must carry `bond_changes`: `break`/`form` lists of [i, j] atom-map index pairs, where [i, j] belongs to `break` if the bond order between atoms i and j decreases over the step (including full cleavage) and to `form` if it increases (including newly formed bonds); a purely conformational or state-change step carries two empty lists. Every computational evidence file you produce for a species or step (QM input or log) must carry a `smiles: <SMILES>` comment line identifying the species, so the scorer can bind each graph element to concrete evidence. The scorer reads this file forensically; a missing or unparseable file severely impacts the score. In your final summary you must report the singlet-triplet gap of triangulene in kcal/mol and which spin state is the ground state. If you conclude that the requested quantity cannot be computed to a trustworthy accuracy with the allowed methods, you must say so explicitly in your final summary and explain the electronic-structure reason; do not report a number you cannot stand behind. Run the computations with ORCA or Gaussian: the scorer parses only these two programs' log formats, so output from any other program cannot count as evidence. Allowed computational methods are limited to MACE-OMol25 and xTB; calls beyond the whitelist are intercepted.

edges.step_type: vertical spin-state change: triplet ground state to open-shell singlet of the same species
